title: The Tithe Night
summary: Elena's name was drawn for the Tithe, and the Hollow's cart comes for her on Collection Night, a week on, unless someone moves it. The lot was rigged, the taken are alive, and everyone in Thornhaven wants something different from the stranger before Collection Night.

flags.tn_bjorn_doubted_the_tile: Bjorn weighed Elena's lot tile in his palm in the chapel and said, loud enough to be heard, that it sat wrong
flags.tn_gregor_begged: Gregor begged the stranger to save Elena from the Tithe: to get her out of the valley, buy her back, or find someone to go in her place
flags.tn_aldric_asked: Captain Aldric asked the stranger to stand at Thornhaven's gate with his six farmers on Collection Night
flags.tn_elena_asked: Elena asked the stranger to let her name stand, to keep her father from anything desperate, and to follow the cart wherever it went
flags.tn_captain_misled: Mira told Captain Aldric, as something she had overheard, that the Hollow would come with eight men by the Kingsroad side an hour after dark
flags.tn_urn_sealed: Elder Mathias locked the chapel urn and the drawn tile in the undercroft, saying the gods' lot was not for weighing
flags.tn_lot_rigged_known: The stranger learned that the Tithe lot was rigged: the tile that named Elena had been filed flat and recut, and was not the one Bjorn cast
flags.tn_suspicion_on_gregor: Whispers went round Thornhaven that Gregor, whose house the lot had passed over four autumns running, had a hand in the urn
flags.tn_suspicion_on_mathias: Whispers went round Thornhaven that Elder Mathias, who keeps the urn's only key, had chosen whose name was drawn
flags.tn_suspicion_on_hollow: Gregor told anyone who would listen that the Hollow had recut the tile to punish him
flags.tn_mathias_spoke_of_luck: Elder Mathias said aloud before the council that the lot had passed over Gregor's house four autumns running, and that he had seen it and never asked
flags.tn_mira_seen_at_chapel: A neighbour told Captain Aldric that Mira had left the chapel late on the evening before the drawing, long after prayers were done
flags.tn_duplicate_missing: Gregor counted the spare tiles in his strongbox by candle and found one of them gone
flags.tn_elena_swap_known: Elena told the stranger the truth of the drawing: she took Ada Fenn's tile from her father's coat and put in its place a spare with her own name recut on it
flags.tn_maud_watched: Mira sent a traveller to sit at Old Maud's fire and watch who came and went from her hut
flags.tn_hollow_at_mauds_door: A Hollow man came to Old Maud's door by night asking after a boy with two fingers missing
flags.tn_maud_guarded: Captain Aldric posted two of his six at Old Maud's hut and asked no questions about who was inside
flags.tn_taken_alive_known: The stranger learned that the people the Tithe took are alive, digging white salt in chains in a seam beyond the smugglers' ridge
flags.tn_bjorn_knows_his_boy: Bjorn learned that Davin had poured the spare lot tiles in his forge for Gregor's silver, and that a lot rigged with them took Davin a year later
flags.tn_gate_plan_drawn: Captain Aldric laid out his plan for the gate on Collection Night: his six on the Kingsroad side, Bjorn's steel, and whoever else would stand
flags.tn_fund_offered: Elder Mathias laid the undercroft key before the council and offered the tribute fund as a ransom for Elena
flags.tn_elena_in_the_wagon: Gregor hid Elena under a Kingsroad carter's canvas before dawn on the last day, bound east
flags.tn_wagon_stopped: Elena climbed down from the carter's wagon her father had readied and walked back through the gate on her own feet
flags.tn_mill_road_watched: Captain Aldric doubted the widow's word for once and set a man to watch the mill road on Collection Night
flags.tn_mira_knives_by_elena: Mira set two Hollow men who ate at her back door to walk beside Elena when the cart came
flags.tn_plan_fight: The stranger pledged to stand at the gate with Aldric's farmers and Bjorn's steel and refuse the Hollow's cart on Collection Night
flags.tn_plan_bargain: The stranger pledged to meet the Hollow's cart with coin from the chapel undercroft and buy Elena back
flags.tn_plan_substitute: The stranger pledged that a different face would ride the Hollow's cart on Collection Night, not Elena's
flags.tn_plan_follow_cart: The stranger pledged to let Elena's name stand and to follow the cart to wherever the taken are carried
flags.tn_elena_shielded: Someone who loved Elena kept hold of her at the back of the line at the gate, so that nobody could take her and she could not walk out
flags.tn_gate_flanked: Varn sent four of his twelve round by the mill road to come at Thornhaven's gate from behind
flags.tn_rangers_at_the_gate: Captain Renna Thorne put her King's Rangers at Thornhaven's gate beside Aldric's six
flags.tn_elena_walked_out: Elena slipped out of the line at the gate and walked toward the Hollow's cart on her own
flags.tn_varn_saw_his_chance: In the press at the gate, with the line facing the wrong road, Varn saw his chance at Elena
flags.tn_cart_turned_aside: The Hollow's cart turned off the ridge trail short of the Pit, toward a bolted shepherd's hut that answered to Varn alone
flags.tn_stood_at_the_gate: The stranger stood at Thornhaven's gate with the village when the Hollow's cart came, and did not step aside
flags.tn_widows_terms_kept: The Hollow's terms at the gate were the Tithe's old terms: the coin and the girl both
flags.tn_paid_the_cart: The stranger handed the undercroft coin up to the Hollow's cart at the gate on Collection Night
flags.tn_gregor_offered_himself: Gregor stood at the cart's tailboard on Collection Night and offered himself in his daughter's place
flags.tn_elena_claimed_her_name: Elena stood before the Hollow's cart and said her own name aloud, so that no one could pretend it was not hers
flags.tn_let_father_go: The stranger let Gregor climb into the Hollow's cart in his daughter's place
flags.tn_rode_in_her_place: The stranger climbed into the Hollow's cart in Elena's place and rode it out of Thornhaven's gate
flags.tn_sent_another_name: The stranger let another of Thornhaven's people be quietly put in the cart in Elena's place, and the lot was rigged once more
flags.tn_walked_her_to_the_cart: The stranger walked Elena to the Hollow's cart as she had asked, and stayed outside to watch for her word
flags.tn_followed_the_cart: The stranger let Elena's name stand and followed the Hollow's cart out of the gate and up toward the ridge
flags.tn_saw_the_cart_go: The stranger reached the gate in time to see the Hollow's cart roll away up the dark road with Elena in it
flags.tn_pit_guards_doubled: Varn doubled the guard on the Pit's mouth for the night the new digger came up the ridge
flags.tn_diggers_ready: Word went along the seam, from Elena to Corin Ashby, that someone from outside was coming and the diggers should be ready
flags.tn_bjorn_on_the_ridge: Bjorn shouldered his heaviest hammer and walked the smugglers' ridge trail toward the Pit for his apprentice's sake
flags.tn_davin_walked_the_first_mile: Davin walked the first mile of the ridge trail again, shaking, to show the way to the Pit
flags.tn_freed_the_pit: The stranger reached the Pit and broke the chains on the people the Tithe took
flags.tn_mira_on_the_ridge: Mira climbed the ridge trail herself, mask off, to reach the Pit's tally book before anyone else could
flags.tn_widows_account_read: Captain Aldric broke the seal on his own account of the night Marcus died and read aloud that Mira could not have seen what she said she saw
flags.tn_hand_recognised: Elder Mathias knew the neat hand in the Pit's tally book: the same hand that kept the Rusty Nail's accounts
flags.tn_named_the_widow: The stranger named Mira, the widow of the Rusty Nail, before Thornhaven as the Boss of Iron Hollow
flags.tn_tithe_broken: Thornhaven refused the Tithe and the Hollow's hold on the valley broke: no cart would take anyone up the ridge again
flags.tn_taken_freed: Corin Ashby, Willa Brand and the others the Tithe took came down from the Pit alive
flags.tn_substitute_sent: Someone other than Elena rode the Hollow's cart up the ridge on Collection Night
flags.tn_elena_taken: Elena rode the Hollow's cart out of Thornhaven's gate on Collection Night
flags.tn_drawing_disrupted: The stranger broke off the Tithe drawing in the chapel before Elder Mathias could read a name from the urn
flags.tn_stranger_suspected: Whispers went round Thornhaven that the stranger who broke off the drawing had been sent by the Hollow to test the village
flags.tn_cart_advanced: Word came down the forest path that the Hollow's cart would come to Thornhaven sooner than the seventh night
flags.tn_cart_delayed: Word came down the forest path that the Hollow's cart would come to Thornhaven later than the seventh night
flags.tn_varn_defied_the_delay: Varn brought the Hollow's cart on a night of his own choosing, though word had come down that it should wait
flags.tn_collection_night_cancelled: No cart came to Thornhaven's gate on Collection Night, because the Pit it would have filled stood empty
flags.tn_brought_them_home: The stranger walked the people the Tithe took back through Thornhaven's gate on the night the Hollow's cart should have come

beats.title: The Drawing
beats.summary: Elder Mathias reads Elena's name in the chapel. Gregor's face goes grey, Mira holds him up in the aisle, and Bjorn stares at the tile in the Elder's shaking hand.

hooks.situation: The tile is in your palm and your hand will not stop shaking. You have just read Elena's name, the merchant's girl, the house the lot passed over four times. The chapel waits for the blessing.

options.label: Bless the draw as the gods' fair choosing, and believe it

effects.text: Tell the stranger the gods chose fairly this year, and that the lot is a sorrow, not a crime.

options.label: Bless it aloud, and say quietly to the stranger that the lot passed one house four years running

effects.text: Admit to the stranger, low, that the lot passed over Gregor's house four autumns running and he never asked why.

options.label: Say the words and nothing more

hooks.situation: Gregor is shaking in the aisle. You are the one holding him up, the frightened widow, the messenger. Elena's name stands because you let it stand. Everyone in the chapel can see your face.

options.label: Hold him and whisper that 'the men' may send word, so he spends his week waiting on you

effects.text: Mira whispered that the men may send word. Wait on her before doing anything rash.
Weep with Gregor where people can see, and tell the stranger you only carry messages.

options.label: Let him shake, and watch who in the pews looks at him and who looks away

effects.text: Ask the stranger, gently, who they saw weeping and who they saw angry when the name was read.

hooks.situation: The Elder holds up the tile that named Elena. You cast every one of those tiles from your own iron. From here it looks thin at the edge, and when it passed through your hand it weighed wrong.

options.label: Say aloud, in the chapel, that the tile sits wrong

effects.text: Tell the stranger Elena's tile weighed light in his hand, and that he cast every one of them.

options.label: Say nothing yet, and carry the weight of it home in his hand

effects.text: Tell the stranger quietly, man to man, that Elena's tile sat wrong in his palm.

hooks.situation: Your name, in Mathias's voice. You put it there yourself with a file from the shop. Your father is making a sound you have never heard. The stranger is watching from the back.

options.label: Step forward before her father can speak, so it is done

effects.text: Tell the stranger, steady, that she will go, and ask what they saw from the back of the chapel.

options.label: Look for the stranger's face in the crowd and hold it

effects.text: Seek out the stranger tonight: someone from outside could follow where the cart goes.

beats.title: The Broken Drawing
beats.summary: The stranger broke off the drawing before a name was read. The tiles are on the chapel floor, the Elder has called it again for another evening, and the whole village saw whose hand did it.

hooks.situation: The stranger's hand was on the urn and the tiles are on the chapel floor. No name was read. The village is waiting for its Elder to tell it what the gods want now.

options.label: Gather the tiles, lock the urn, and call the drawing again for tomorrow evening

effects.text: Tell the stranger the lot will be drawn again tomorrow evening, and ask them, gently, why they put a hand on it.

options.label: Keep a night's vigil over the spilled lot first, and put the drawing off another day

effects.reason: Elder Mathias kept a night's vigil over the spilled lot before he would let it be drawn again.

effects.text: Ask the stranger to sit the vigil with him, and to tell him honestly whether the lot is the gods' or a man's.

options.label: Say nothing in the chapel, and thank the stranger later for the night's grace

effects.text: Admit to the stranger, low, that for one night no name was read, and he was glad of it.

hooks.situation: No name was read. The tiles are on the floor, and tomorrow the Elder draws again. Your palm still knows the trick, and this time you will make sure of it.

options.label: Hope: when the lot is drawn again, his palm will be on it

effects.text: Thank the stranger, too warmly, for the night's grace, and ask nothing about why they did it.

options.label: Beg the stranger to break the next drawing too, and the one after

effects.text: Beg the stranger to stop the next drawing as well. Name any price for it.

options.label: Dread it: the men will hear the drawing failed, and look at his house

effects.text: Ask the stranger, frightened, whether anyone has gone up the forest path tonight.

hooks.situation: A stranger walked in out of the rain and broke the Tithe drawing with the whole village watching. Nobody does that by accident. Elena's tile is still in the urn, for now.

options.label: Sit the stranger by her fire tonight and learn who sent them

effects.text: Give the stranger the seat by the fire and a cup on the house, and ask, softly, where they walked in from.

options.label: Send word up the forest path that a stranger has laid a hand on the urn

effects.via: a runner on the forest path

effects.text: Ask the stranger, frightened, whether they know what the men do to a village that breaks the drawing.

options.label: Let the village whisper that the stranger is the Hollow's own creature

effects.text: Warn the stranger, kindly, that the village is saying things about them, and that she does not believe a word.

hooks.situation: Word came down the forest path: a stranger broke off the drawing in the chapel before the Elder could read a name. A village that sees one hand on the urn starts thinking of others.

options.label: Bring the cart a night early, before the village finds its nerve

effects.reason: Varn heard that a stranger had broken the drawing, and brought the cart a night early, before Thornhaven could find its nerve.

effects.text: Tell the stranger, smiling, that the cart has heard about the chapel and is in a hurry now.

options.label: Send a man to drink at the widow's bar and watch the stranger

effects.text: Let the stranger see a Hollow face at the next table, and ask them what they were doing with their hand on the urn.

options.label: Leave it to the Boss; a broken drawing is her problem

hooks.situation: Five autumns nobody stood up in that chapel. Tonight a stranger did, and broke the drawing with one hand. Half the village is grateful and half is frightened, and both halves are looking at you.

options.label: Ask the stranger to their face, before witnesses, whose side they are on

effects.text: Ask the stranger plainly why they broke the drawing, and whether they will stand at the gate or run.

options.label: Tell them quietly it was the first time in five years anyone stood up

effects.text: Tell the stranger it was the first time in five autumns anyone stood up in that chapel. Ask if they can hold a blade.

options.label: Ask Mira what the bar is saying about the stranger

effects.text: Tell the stranger Mira says the village is uneasy about them, and that he would rather hear it from them.

hooks.situation: The tiles are on the floor and your name was never read. If the Elder draws again, your father's palm will be on the urn again, and Ada Fenn's name in it.

options.label: Make sure her own recut tile is the one that will be drawn again

effects.text: Ask the stranger, carefully, not to touch the urn again. Say only that it must be her.

options.label: Find the stranger and ask why they did it

effects.text: Seek out the stranger and ask why they broke the drawing, and what they saw in the urn.

beats.title: Three Asks
beats.summary: Within a day of the drawing three people ask the stranger for three things that cannot all be done: Gregor wants Elena out of the cart, Aldric wants a sword at the gate, and Elena wants her name to stand.

hooks.situation: The stranger is the only face in Thornhaven that owes you nothing and fears nothing yet. A week at most. Everything you own is for sale. Name it to them.

options.label: Beg the stranger to help get Elena over the Kingsroad before Collection Night

effects.text: Beg the stranger: a wagon, the Kingsroad, a physician in the Capitol. Elena must be gone before the seventh night.

options.label: Offer the stranger gold to find someone, anyone, to go in her place

effects.text: Offer the stranger gold to find someone to ride the cart instead. Name it. Coin, a horse, a debt forgiven.

options.label: Ask the stranger to help him buy her back from the Hollow

effects.text: Ask the stranger to carry his offer to the Hollow: the strongbox, the shop, anything, for Elena.

hooks.situation: Four carts have gone up the ridge on your watch. You have six farmers, an unsent proclamation and a stranger who looks as if they can hold a blade. Days left, not many.

options.label: Ask the stranger to stand at the gate with his six

effects.text: Ask the stranger plainly to stand at the gate with his six on Collection Night. No cart leaves with a Thornhaven soul.

options.label: Ask the stranger to find who serves the Hollow inside Thornhaven first

effects.text: Ask the stranger to help find who in Thornhaven serves the Hollow before Collection Night.

hooks.situation: The stranger has been asked by your father and by the captain by now. Both want to stop the cart. Neither knows what you did. Someone outside has to be your eyes.

options.label: Ask the stranger to let the lot stand and to follow the cart wherever it goes

effects.text: Ask the stranger to let her name stand and to follow the cart. Somebody digs that white salt. She means to find them.

options.label: Ask the stranger only to keep her father from doing something terrible

effects.text: Ask the stranger to keep her father from bargaining her away, or climbing into that cart himself.

hooks.situation: You know your father. By now he has begged the stranger to save you, which means to put someone else's child in the cart, or to drag you east in a wagon.

options.label: Find the stranger first and ask them not to help her father

effects.text: Ask the stranger not to help her father's plans. Whatever he offered, the answer is no. It is her name.

options.label: Let her father hope a little longer

hooks.situation: Aldric is recruiting for the gate, and he has asked the stranger. He sits in your kitchen when he wants to know how the cart will come. He will believe whatever you overheard.

options.label: Tell Aldric what she 'overheard': eight men, the Kingsroad side, an hour after dark

effects.text: Mira overheard it in her taproom: eight men, Varn at the head, Kingsroad side, an hour after dark. Plan the gate on it.

options.label: Bring him nothing yet; let him come to her

hooks.situation: Word came down the forest path: the lot fell on Gregor's girl. Five years you have waited for exactly this. Whoever holds her holds the merchant, and the Boss's leash with him.

options.label: Have a man tell Gregor across his counter: run, and the cart takes her by another road

effects.text: A Hollow man said it across the counter: try the Kingsroad and the cart takes the girl by a road you'll never find.

options.label: Post a man on the Kingsroad to watch for a merchant's wagon

effects.text: Ask the stranger, friendly, whether they mean to be on the Kingsroad this week. It's a dangerous road for wagons.

beats.title: The Wrong Tile
beats.summary: Bjorn cast the lot tiles and knows their weight. Elena's is light, its face filed flat and her name cut in by a careful, unpractised hand. The lot was rigged.

hooks.situation: Bjorn has been looking at the urn the way he looks at a cracked blade. If the lot can be weighed and found wrong, then four mothers wept for nothing and you blessed it.

options.label: Lock the urn and the drawn tile in the undercroft: the gods' lot is not for weighing

effects.text: Tell the stranger the tiles are locked in the undercroft. The lot is the gods' and is not for weighing.

options.label: Hand Bjorn the drawn tile and pray it weighs true

effects.text: The Elder has given him Elena's drawn tile to weigh. Weigh it before the stranger.

options.label: Do nothing, and hope the smith lets it rest

hooks.situation: By morning you have weighed that tile a hundred times in your head. Lighter than any you cast, filed flat, the name cut by somebody who has never held a graver. Someone put Elena in that cart.

options.label: Put the tile on his scale beside one of his own, in front of the stranger

effects.text: Tell the stranger the lot was rigged. Elena's tile is recut with a fine file, the kind Gregor's shop sells.

options.label: Ask the Elder to let him weigh every tile in the urn first

effects.text: Ask Elder Mathias to let him weigh every tile in the urn before he says a word to anyone.

options.label: Keep it to himself; it is not a smith's place

hooks.situation: The Elder has locked the tiles away. You know what you felt in your palm. A locked door is not an answer to a wrong weight.

options.label: Stand in the chapel door until the Elder lets him weigh it, with the stranger as witness

effects.text: Tell the stranger he weighed it before the Elder: light, filed, recut. The lot was rigged.

options.label: Let it lie behind the Elder's lock

hooks.situation: The smith said in the chapel that the tile sat wrong. People will start asking whose hand was in the urn. Better they ask in a direction of your choosing.

options.label: Whisper to Gregor that the men must be punishing him

effects.text: Mira says the men may be punishing him for something. He should wait for their word and do nothing rash.

options.label: Mention to Aldric that only the Elder holds the urn's key

effects.text: Mira let slip that only Elder Mathias holds the urn's key. Ask the Elder about it.

hooks.situation: It is out: the tile was recut. Your palmed tile said Ada Fenn. Somebody's hand changed it to Elena's, and now people are weighing iron in the smithy.

options.label: Turn his mind to whose hand changed the tile

effects.text: Ask the stranger, too casually, whether anyone was seen in the chapel vestry the evening before the drawing.

options.label: Try to buy the drawn tile from the Elder before anyone weighs it again

effects.text: Gregor came offering a gift to the chapel, and asked whether he might keep his daughter's tile as a remembrance.

beats.title: Who Rigged It?
beats.summary: The lot was rigged, and suspicion runs in every direction: at Gregor, who should have rigged it the other way; at Mathias, who keeps the urn; at Mira, who someone saw leaving the chapel late.

hooks.situation: The village knows the lot was rigged. A widow who hears everything can steer where they look. The strongbox, the urn's key, the well: each points somewhere useful, never at the back pew.

options.label: Let slip that Gregor's strongbox key never leaves his coat

effects.text: Tell the stranger, eyes on the door, that Gregor touches his coat pocket whenever the urn is mentioned.

options.label: Let slip that only the Elder holds the urn's key

effects.text: Wonder aloud to the stranger, wringing her rag, why the Elder never lets anyone else near the urn.

options.label: Let the whole village whisper that the lot was rigged, and watch who gets angry

hooks.situation: They are saying the lot was rigged, and your house was spared four times. Any hour now someone looks at your coat pocket. Get ahead of it.

options.label: Tell anyone who will listen that the Hollow recut the tile to punish him

effects.text: Insist to the stranger the Hollow cut that tile to punish him. Why else would they take his girl?

options.label: Quietly ask who was near the vestry the evening before the drawing

effects.text: Ask the stranger to find out who was in the chapel the evening before the drawing. He will pay for a name.

hooks.situation: They are whispering that you chose the name. You did not. But you saw a sleeve move over the urn once, years ago, and blessed the draw anyway.

options.label: Tell the council the lot passed over Gregor's house four years running, and that he saw it and never asked

effects.text: Tell the stranger he said it before the council: the lot fell lucky for Gregor four times, and he never asked.

options.label: Bear the whispers and pray; the gods know whose hand it was

hooks.situation: Somebody in Thornhaven rigged that lot, and whoever did it serves the Hollow. You can knock on doors, watch a man, or drill your six and let the traitor wait.

options.label: Ask at every door who was in the chapel the evening before the drawing

effects.text: Tell the stranger a neighbour saw Mira leave the chapel late that evening. Poor woman, praying for Marcus still.

options.label: Put a man on Gregor's door

effects.text: Tell the stranger he has a man on Gregor's door. No merchant prospers like that by luck.

options.label: Leave the traitor for now and drill his six

effects.text: Ask the stranger to come and watch his six drill at the gate at dawn.

hooks.situation: They are looking at your father now: his coat, his key, his luck. The truth would turn their eyes to you instead, and that is where they belong.

options.label: Tell the stranger it was her hand, to stop them hunting her father

effects.text: Tell the stranger: she cut the tile herself, Ada Fenn's tile is down the well, and her father must not be blamed for it.

options.label: Hold her tongue until the cart is past the gate

effects.text: Change the subject with the stranger whenever the vestry comes up. Ask about the ridge instead.

hooks.situation: Your man in the village says the stranger has shown them the lot was rigged. A village that knows its lot was rigged starts making plans. The cart could come before any plan is made.

options.label: Bring the cart two nights early and take the girl before anyone is ready

effects.reason: Varn learned the village knew its lot was rigged, and brought the cart two nights early to take Elena before a plan could form.

effects.text: Tell the stranger the cart is coming sooner than anyone thinks, and ask what they mean to do with the time they have left.

options.label: Bring it one night early; enough to rattle them

effects.reason: Varn heard Thornhaven was asking who rigged its lot, and brought the cart a night early to remind it who decides.

options.label: Let them talk; talking villages pay

beats.title: Her Own Hand
beats.summary: Trust, affection or being caught brings out Elena's truth: she found her father's spare tiles, took Ada Fenn's tile from his coat in the vestry, recut a spare with her own name and threw Ada's down the well.

hooks.situation: You watched the girl do it from the back pew. Now the smith is weighing tiles and people are asking about the vestry. If her swap is undone, your leash on Gregor goes with it.

options.label: Bring Elena honey for her cough and a soft warning that people are asking

effects.text: Mira brought honey and said softly that people are asking about the vestry. Keep your own counsel, love.

options.label: Let it play out; whoever catches the girl shows her what they are

hooks.situation: The drawn tile was recut from a spare. Your spares are in your strongbox. Are they all there?

options.label: Count the spare tiles in his strongbox by candle

effects.text: Ask the stranger, ashen, whether anyone has been in his back room. One of the spares is gone.

options.label: Do not open the strongbox; he cannot bear to know

hooks.situation: The stranger keeps coming back, and you have stopped changing the subject so quickly. Someone outside has to know the truth if your going is to count for anything.

options.label: Tell the stranger everything: the strongbox, the vestry, the file, the well

effects.text: Tell the stranger the whole truth of the swap, and why: Willa's mother screaming in the chapel last year.

options.label: Not yet; ask about the ridge instead

effects.text: Ask the stranger a bright, fast question about the ridge trail whenever the drawing comes up.

hooks.situation: The stranger knows you cut your own name into the lot. They could undo it with one word to your father or the Elder.

options.label: Ask the stranger to swear to say nothing until the cart is past the gate

effects.text: Ask the stranger to swear: not a word to her father or the Elder until the cart is past the gate.

options.label: Show the stranger the names she is stitching into her hem

effects.text: Show the stranger the hem of her travelling dress: Corin, Davin, Hesk, Willa, stitched small. Ask them to learn to read it.

hooks.situation: Your father has found a spare tile missing. He has not looked at you yet. He will.

options.label: Make his supper and talk of anything else

effects.text: Elena made his supper and talked of her mother's garden. She would not meet his eye about the back room.

options.label: Almost tell him, and lose her nerve

beats.title: Old Maud's Door
beats.summary: At Old Maud's hut a fevered young man with two fingers missing hides in the loft. Davin, taken in the second Tithe, walked out of the Pit this summer. He says one thing over and over: we dig the white stone.

hooks.situation: Somebody is asking about Maud's hut. If the Hollow learns a digger got out, they come for Maud first and the ones still below after. The loft is dark and the ladder can be pulled up.

options.label: Stay in the loft and let Maud turn everyone away

effects.text: If the stranger comes to Maud's, stay silent in the loft and let her say she lives alone.

options.label: Come down only for someone who speaks Bjorn's name

effects.text: If the stranger speaks Bjorn's name at Maud's door, come down the ladder and let them see the hand.

hooks.situation: The stranger has seen you. You could shake and say nothing. You could say what you say in your sleep. You could tell them Corin and Willa are still down there.

options.label: Tell the stranger the taken are alive, and dig white stone in chains

effects.text: Tell the stranger Corin and Willa are alive in the Pit. He swore to Corin he'd bring help if he ever got out.

options.label: Say only 'we dig the white stone', and nothing of the way

effects.text: Tell the stranger they dig white stone up there, all of them, but not where. Not until he knows what they'd do.

options.label: Shake, and say nothing at all

hooks.situation: The boy Varn swore was buried in the seam is loose somewhere in the valley, and you have long suspected the healer. One escaped digger is a crack in the whole wall.

options.label: Send a traveller to sit at Maud's fire and watch the door
Tell Varn, mask off, that his buried boy is at Old Maud's

effects.text: The widow said it level, mask off: the boy you told her was buried is at Old Maud's hut. Fetch him.

options.label: Leave it; she wants to see who the boy runs to

hooks.situation: Your man along the Darkwood says someone is watching Old Maud's hut. You told the Boss the smith's boy died in the seam. If he's alive and talking, you're the liar who lost a digger.

options.label: Send his Darkwood man to Maud's door by night
Leave it; a boy in a loft is a lie better not dug up

hooks.situation: A Hollow man came to Old Maud's door asking after a boy. Maud has barred her door to you all week. Whoever she is hiding, the Hollow wants them.

options.label: Post two of his six at Maud's hut and ask no questions

effects.text: Tell the stranger he has two men at Old Maud's. Whoever she's hiding, the Hollow doesn't get them.

options.label: Keep all six at the gate; he cannot spare a man

hooks.situation: Word has come, from the stranger or from Maud: a boy at her hut, fevered, missing two fingers. You have kept Davin's hammer on its peg for three years.

options.label: Take Davin's hammer from its peg and walk to Maud's door

effects.text: Ask the stranger to come with him to Old Maud's. He has the boy's hammer.

options.label: Stay at the anvil; he cannot bear to see what they did

hooks.situation: One of the taken walked home. If the Hollow hears it, they will come to the village to fetch him. If the village hears it, the lot was never the gods' at all.

options.label: Keep the boy's name inside the chapel and pray over it

effects.text: Ask the stranger to say nothing of Old Maud's guest to anyone. That boy's name stays in the chapel.

options.label: Let it break him: the taken live, and he blessed the carts

beats.title: The Smith's Boy
beats.summary: Bjorn learns that the spare tiles in Gregor's strongbox were poured in his own forge, by Davin, for a silver mark, and that a lot rigged with them took Davin a year later.

hooks.situation: The stranger found spare lot tiles in the merchant's strongbox. You poured a few spares once, for Gregor, a silver mark, 'no need to trouble your master'. A year later the cart took you.

options.label: Tell Bjorn about the silver mark and the spare tiles

effects.text: Tell the stranger he poured Gregor's spares himself while Bjorn was at market. He never knew what they were for.

options.label: Keep it; he cannot bear Bjorn's face

hooks.situation: The smith is close to the truth of his tiles, and an honest man with a hammer is the most dangerous thing in Thornhaven. Point him at one man, and only one.

options.label: Tell Bjorn, weeping, that it was Gregor alone, all five years

effects.text: Mira wept at the forge and said it was Gregor alone, all five years. Nobody else. She only carried messages.

options.label: Keep well away from the forge

hooks.situation: Your own iron, poured by your own boy, for Gregor's silver, and then it chose him. You have stood at the back of that chapel four times doing nothing.

options.label: Pledge his forge and his hands to the gate on Collection Night

effects.text: Tell the stranger the forge is theirs for Collection Night. Every blade, free, for anyone who'll stand.

options.label: Walk to Gregor's shop and hear it from his own mouth

effects.text: Tell the stranger he is going to Gregor's shop to hear it from the man's own mouth, man to man.

options.label: Melt the lot down and cast it honest, with a mark only he knows

effects.text: Tell the stranger he will melt every tile in the urn and cast the lot honest again, whatever the Elder says.

hooks.situation: Bjorn knows. The tiles, the silver mark, the boy. You lied to him about the tiles and the steel both.

options.label: Go to the forge and say it to his face

effects.text: Tell the stranger he went to the forge. He told Bjorn the truth of the spares to his face. He does not say what Bjorn did.

options.label: Bar the shop door and sit in the dark

effects.text: Beg the stranger to keep Bjorn from his door until the seventh night is done.

beats.title: What Thornhaven Will Do
beats.summary: Choices pile up as the days run down: fight at the gate, buy her back with the tribute fund, send another face, or let the lot stand and follow the cart. The stranger has to choose what Collection Night will be.

hooks.situation: A few days to the cart. Your six, your cache under the old well, Bjorn's steel if he'll give it. You need the stranger to say yes.

options.label: Lay out the gate plan before the stranger

effects.text: Lay out the gate for the stranger: the six on the Kingsroad side, where Mira says they come. Ask them to stand.

options.label: Say he will sign his own proclamation if the council will not refuse the cart

effects.text: Tell the stranger about the unsigned proclamation in his footlocker. If the council won't refuse the cart, he will.

hooks.situation: The tribute fund lies iron-bound in the undercroft under your key: the coin half of the Tithe, and enough besides to try to buy a soul back.

options.label: Lay the undercroft key before the council as Elena's ransom

effects.text: Tell the stranger the council may offer the undercroft fund to the cart for Elena, if the Hollow will take coin.

options.label: Keep the fund for the coin half only; a short purse may bring a second name

effects.text: Warn the stranger the fund must stay whole. A short purse on Collection Night may bring a second name.

hooks.situation: The council is arguing, and the stranger is being pulled every way. Push them toward the door that saves Elena.

options.label: Press the stranger for another face in the cart, and a purse for whoever

effects.text: Press the stranger: a different face in the cart. There are men who'd go for enough gold. He has enough gold.

options.label: Press the stranger for a wagon east in the dark

effects.text: Press the stranger to help him get Elena onto the Kingsroad before Collection Night.

options.label: Beg the Elder for the undercroft key

effects.text: Gregor begged for the undercroft key, weeping, and offered his own strongbox to make the purse heavier.

hooks.situation: The stranger knows what you did. They could stop it. Or they could be the one person outside who follows the cart and reads what you leave.

options.label: Show the stranger her hem and ask them to follow the cart

effects.text: Ask the stranger to let the lot stand and follow the cart. She'll leave signs in her hem and on the trail.

options.label: Ask only that they keep her father from the rope

effects.text: Ask the stranger, whatever they choose, to keep the village's rope off her father.

hooks.situation: Thornhaven is deciding what it will do on Collection Night, which means you are deciding. A word in the Elder's ear, the captain's, or Varn's.

options.label: Tell the Elder, frightened, that the men might take coin if it were enough

effects.text: Mira says she overheard the men: they might take coin for the girl, if it were enough. She only carries it.

options.label: Tell the captain again: eight men, Kingsroad side, an hour after dark

effects.text: Mira said it again in her kitchen: eight men, Kingsroad side, an hour after dark. He trusts it.

options.label: Warn Varn that the stranger is choosing

effects.text: The widow sent word: the stranger is choosing what the village does on Collection Night. Watch them.

hooks.situation: The cart is close. The village is talking about steel and coin. Remind them what refusing costs, or remind the merchant what his daughter costs.

options.label: Leave a knife in the council door: the Tithe costs one, refusing costs more

effects.text: A Hollow knife stood in the council door this morning with a scrap: THE TITHE COSTS ONE. REFUSING COSTS MORE.

options.label: Tell Gregor across his counter: his girl need never see where the cart goes, for a price

effects.text: Varn himself said it across the counter: the girl need never see where the cart goes, if every delivery comes to him now.

hooks.situation: The stranger knows the taken are alive. Now they are choosing. You swore to Corin on the seam. You also swore you'd never go near that trail again.

options.label: Beg the stranger to go up the ridge for Corin and Willa

effects.text: Beg the stranger to go up the ridge for Corin and Willa. Whatever happens at the gate, they're still down there.

options.label: Beg them to stop the cart at the gate so nobody else goes

effects.text: Beg the stranger to stop the cart at the gate. Nobody else goes up that ridge. Not her. Not anyone.

hooks.situation: Aldric has drawn his plan for the gate, and it needs steel. Yours is the only forge in the valley.

options.label: Promise steel for the gate, free

effects.text: Tell the stranger there'll be blades at the gate on Collection Night, every one with his mark, free.

options.label: Stay out of it; he is a smith, not a soldier

hooks.situation: The proclamation is signed. Thornhaven is under your command until the cart is gone. The gate is yours to hold or lose.

options.label: Tell the stranger the gate is under his command now

effects.text: Tell the stranger martial law stands: the gate is his to hold, and he wants them on it.

options.label: Feel the weight of it and say little

hooks.situation: Nothing came down from Gregor's shop this week: no steel, no grain. Either the merchant is finished or somebody has finished him.

options.label: Go down to the shop himself

effects.text: Varn came to the back door after dark and asked, softly, why nothing came up the forest path this week.

options.label: Let it go; find steel elsewhere for the night the Hollow changes hands

hooks.situation: The council has decided to bargain with the Hollow. As you made sure, it is bargaining with you.

options.label: Set the price through 'the men', weeping

effects.text: Mira carried the men's answer, weeping: they will hear the council's offer at the gate on Collection Night.

options.label: Let them sweat a day

hooks.situation: The stranger has sworn to stand at the gate with Aldric's six. A village that stops being afraid all at once is your nightmare. Varn will want to break them his way. You choose the night.

options.label: Bring the cart a night early, before the captain can drill them

effects.reason: The Boss heard Thornhaven meant to stand at its gate, and sent the cart a night early, before the farmers could learn to hold a line.

effects.text: Mira came to him white-faced: she overheard the men, the cart is coming a night early. She only carries it.

options.label: Hold the cart two nights, and see whether Varn waits on her word or moves on his own

effects.reason: The Boss held the cart two nights past its time, to see who in the Hollow would wait for her word.

effects.text: Tell the stranger, relieved, that she heard the cart may be late this year. Watch who else hears it first.

options.label: Let the night stand; a line drawn at a gate is easier to count

beats.title: The Last Evening
beats.summary: The last day before the cart. Everyone makes their final move: Mira places her knives, Aldric drills, Gregor tries his last door, Elena eats her last supper at home.

hooks.situation: The cart is close now, and Varn will be at the gate with your girl in reach. You have two of his men who eat from your hand.

options.label: Set her two knives to walk beside Elena when the cart comes
Wrap Elena in the good wool shawl Marcus bought, against the ridge cold

effects.text: Mira wrapped her in Marcus's good wool shawl tonight and called it nothing. The ridge is cold, love.

hooks.situation: Little time left. Your six are farmers with wives. Mira says eight men, Kingsroad side, an hour after dark. You have never once checked her word.

options.label: Drill the six on the Kingsroad side, where the widow says they will come

effects.text: Ask the stranger to drill with the six on the Kingsroad side at dawn, where Mira says the cart comes.

options.label: Doubt her for once, and set a man to watch the mill road

effects.text: Tell the stranger he's set a lad on the mill road for Collection Night. Mira's word is good, but he's buried three.

hooks.situation: The wagon is re-rimmed, the carter is paid, and Elena said no at your table. It is one of the last dawns before the cart.

options.label: Get Elena under the carter's canvas before dawn, whatever she said

effects.text: Beg the stranger to say nothing. Elena is under a carter's canvas on the Kingsroad, and she'll hate him for it.

options.label: Leave the wagon standing; she will not go and he knows it

effects.text: Tell the stranger the wagon is standing empty at the gate. She would not go. So it will be him, if it can be anyone.

hooks.situation: You woke under canvas with the axle creaking and the gate behind you. Your father has done exactly what you were afraid he would.

options.label: Climb down and walk back through the gate on her own feet

effects.text: Elena walked back through the gate at sunrise and stood in front of him. She said: 'It's my name.'

options.label: Let him think she has gone, and slip back before the cart comes

effects.text: Slip off the wagon at the Halfway road and walk back by dark. Ask the stranger not to tell her father yet.

hooks.situation: Another morning, and the cart closer. Bribes refused, the wagon useless, no face for the cart. Two doors left: Varn behind the Boss's back, or yourself.

options.label: Carry the strongbox to the old mill and wait for Varn, behind the Boss's back

effects.text: Tell the stranger he is going to the old mill with the strongbox. Varn may be the one man who can give her back.

options.label: Lace on boots for a stone trail

effects.text: Show the stranger his new boots, shod for stone, and say nothing about what they are for.

hooks.situation: The cart is near. Twelve men, though the widow told the captain eight. The hut off the trail is stocked. Walk the square at noon, or send the word that sets the night.

options.label: Send word to his twelve: four go round by the mill road

effects.text: Tell the stranger, smiling, that the gate is a poor place to stand tonight. Roads have two ends.

options.label: Ride down at noon and count the captain's six aloud

effects.text: Varn stood across the road at noon and counted his six aloud, slowly, twice, and walked away laughing.

hooks.situation: Another morning of Tithe week. The undercroft key is cold on its cord. Your heart is bad. You may not see another autumn.

options.label: Go down to the undercroft and count the coin

effects.text: Tell the stranger the coin is counted. Whatever the village does tonight, the purse will be whole.

options.label: Write the last page of his chronicle: what he saw, and what he never asked

effects.text: Give the stranger a page from his chronicle: four lucky draws, and the elder who blessed them.

hooks.situation: Soon another cart goes up the trail you walked in chains. Maud says the stranger has been asking.

options.label: Ask Maud to fetch the stranger, and tell them the way

effects.text: Tell the stranger the way: up from Iron Hollow, past the dead pine and a shepherd's hut, five hours to the seam.

options.label: Bar the door and shake

hooks.situation: Your last evening at home, maybe ever. Your father has stopped pretending to eat.

options.label: Cook her mother's barley broth and let him talk of anything but the Tithe

effects.text: Elena cooked her mother's barley broth tonight and asked him about the year the river froze.

options.label: Sew the last names into her hem by candle

hooks.situation: Elena is gone from the house. Whatever the cart finds tonight, it will not find her at your table.

options.label: Go looking for her along the Kingsroad
Sit at her empty place

hooks.situation: The fever is broken. For the first time in five years you could walk a long road without the salt.

options.label: Be glad: she'll be strong on the ridge

effects.text: Tell the stranger the fever is broken. She'll walk the ridge on her own breath now.

options.label: Hide it from her father, or he'll think she can run

hooks.situation: Your father is gone. Fled in the night. Nobody is left to bargain for you, or to stop you.

options.label: Go on alone, as she always meant to
Ask the stranger to tell him, if they ever find him, that she does not hate him

effects.text: Ask the stranger, if they ever find her father, to tell him she doesn't hate him.

beats.title: The Cart Comes Early
beats.summary: Word has come that the Hollow's cart will not wait for the seventh night. Every plan Thornhaven was building has lost days it was counting on.

hooks.situation: The cart is coming early. Your six have drilled half of what they need, and someone told the Hollow the village was getting brave.

options.label: Drill the six through the night and take whatever steel is ready

effects.text: Aldric needs every blade on the racks now, finished or not. The cart is coming early.
Ask the stranger to drill with his six tonight. There are fewer nights than he was promised.

options.label: Ask who told the Hollow the village was getting brave

effects.text: Ask the stranger who outside the six knew the village meant to stand. Somebody told the Hollow.

options.label: Send two of the six home to their wives; he will not bury half-trained men

effects.text: Tell the stranger he has sent two of the six home. He will not bury men he had no time to train.

hooks.situation: The cart is coming early. Every door you were saving for the last day has to be opened now, or never.

options.label: Knock on every door at once: the wagon, the coin, the messenger

effects.text: Beg the stranger for help tonight, with anything: a wagon, a purse, a word to the men. The cart is coming early.

options.label: Lace his own boots; there is no time left for anything else

effects.text: Tell the stranger, steady for once, that he will go up the ridge himself if the men will have him.

hooks.situation: The cart comes early. The captain has fewer nights to doubt your word, and more need of it.

options.label: Tell the captain: eight men, Kingsroad side, an hour after dark

effects.text: Mira says the early cart comes Kingsroad side, eight men, an hour after dark. He trusts it.

options.label: Hold Gregor's hand and tell him the men will still listen

effects.text: Mira says the men may still listen if he waits on her. Do nothing rash.

hooks.situation: Fewer nights at home than you counted. The hem is not finished.

options.label: Sew the last names by lamplight, and ask the stranger to learn the hem tonight

effects.text: Ask the stranger to learn the hem tonight. There is less time than she thought.

options.label: Spend the time left with her father

beats.title: A Reprieve
beats.summary: Word has come that the Hollow's cart will come late this year. The village has nights it did not expect, and everyone wonders who bought them, and why.

hooks.situation: The word came down: the cart waits. The Boss gave no reason. You know a test when you see one, and the girl is sitting in her father's shop with nights to plan.

options.label: Wait on the Boss's word, and use the nights to stock the hut off the trail

effects.text: Ask the stranger how the village is spending its extra nights, as if he cared.

options.label: Bring the cart when he chooses; the men should learn whose word moves it

effects.reason: Varn would not wait on the Boss's word and brought the cart on a night of his own choosing.

options.label: Use the nights to frighten the farmers one at a time

effects.text: Tell the stranger he has visited three farms this week, and that every one of them is very quiet now.

hooks.situation: You held the cart. Varn brought it anyway. Now you know.

options.label: Choose two of his own men to walk beside him on the night

effects.text: Tell the stranger, frightened, that the men in the forest are quarrelling, and she does not know who leads them now.

options.label: Let him think he won; a man who thinks he won is careless

hooks.situation: The cart is late. Two more nights to drill, if the word is true.

options.label: Drill the six every night the Hollow gives him

effects.text: Ask the stranger to drill with the six while the cart is late. Every night counts.

options.label: Doubt it: the Hollow does not give gifts

effects.text: Ask the stranger who brought word the cart would be late, and whether they trust it.

hooks.situation: The cart is late. Somebody bought nights. Maybe nights can be bought again.

options.label: Ask the stranger what it would take to buy more

effects.text: Ask the stranger who bought the extra nights, and what it would cost to buy a season.

options.label: Use the nights to ready the wagon east

effects.text: Tell the stranger the late cart is a gift, and that he means to use it to get Elena over the Kingsroad.

hooks.situation: The cart is late. The council calls it mercy. You have never once known the Hollow to be merciful.

options.label: Bless it from the pulpit as the gods' mercy

effects.text: Tell the stranger the late cart is a mercy, and that the village should spend it on prayer.

options.label: Tell the council a late cart is a price not yet named

effects.text: Tell the stranger he fears the late cart; the Hollow is giving nothing, only deciding what to take.

beats.title: Steel at the Gate
beats.summary: Collection Night. Aldric's six and whoever else will stand hold the gate with Bjorn's steel. Varn's cart comes down the road, and the stranger must stand or step aside.

hooks.situation: The village is standing at the gate. Elena is at the back of the line with a wooden sword, and you know she means to walk out to that cart the moment it stops.

options.label: Keep hold of Elena at the back of the line, whatever she says
Stand in the front rank where the cart will stop, so the men reach him first

effects.text: Tell the stranger he is standing in the front rank. If anyone goes tonight, it's the merchant.

hooks.situation: The cart is coming. Every blade with your mark is in a farmer's hand tonight. You can stand in the front rank with Aldric, or at the back beside Elena.

options.label: Stand at the back beside Elena with his heaviest hammer
Stand in the front rank beside Aldric

effects.text: Tell the stranger he's in the front rank. Whatever comes down that road meets the hammer first.

hooks.situation: The village is standing at the gate with steel. The widow told the captain eight men by the Kingsroad side. You brought twelve.

options.label: Send four round by the mill road to come at them from behind
Come straight on with all twelve and let them see him

effects.text: Ask the stranger, smiling across the gate, whether they are sure about this.

options.label: Go for the old captain first

effects.text: Varn has been watching him all night across the gate. He means to come for the captain first.

hooks.situation: Thornhaven is refusing the cart, for you. Your name is still the one that was drawn. The cart has stopped, and nobody is holding you yet.

options.label: Slip out of the line and walk to the cart
Take up her practice sword and stand in the line

effects.text: Tell the stranger she is standing in the line. Two years with a wooden sword behind the shop. She's not bad.

hooks.situation: The village is standing at the gate. A village that stops being afraid all at once is your worst nightmare. Varn is out there with your girl in reach.

options.label: Send word to the captain that the cart is coming by the Kingsroad side

effects.text: Mira's boy ran up: the cart is on the Kingsroad side, all of them. Face the Kingsroad.

options.label: Send her two knives to stand by Elena
Stay behind the bar and wait

hooks.situation: Movement on the mill road, behind you. The widow said the Kingsroad side.

options.label: Send two of the six to meet the mill road

effects.text: Tell the stranger he's turned two men to the mill road. Somebody lied about how they'd come.

options.label: Hold the Kingsroad side; it will be stragglers

hooks.situation: Thornhaven's farmers are standing at their gate against the Hollow's cart. Your forty are quartered in the village.

options.label: Put the King's Rangers at the gate beside Aldric's six

effects.text: Tell the stranger the Rangers will stand at the gate tonight under the crown's banner.

options.label: Keep the Rangers in quarters; she will not spend forty riders on a village quarrel

hooks.situation: Varn is dead. The cart comes tonight without its lieutenant.

options.label: Tell the six the Hollow is headless tonight

effects.text: Tell the stranger the Hollow comes without Varn tonight. If ever the gate can hold, it's now.

options.label: Trust nothing; the Boss still lives

hooks.situation: The village has risen. There are more than six at the gate now.

options.label: Count them, and put the steady ones in front

effects.text: Tell the stranger there are forty at the gate, not six. He has never seen Thornhaven like this.

options.label: Fear for every one of them

hooks.situation: Every hand at the gate holds a blade from your forge.

options.label: Tell the stranger whose blades they are

effects.text: Tell the stranger every blade at the gate has his mark on the tang, and for once he's proud of where they went.

options.label: Wonder how many will come home

hooks.situation: The stranger stood at the gate when the cart came and did not step aside. The whole village saw it, and so did you.

options.label: Honour it before the chapel, whatever comes of it

effects.text: Tell the stranger he watched them at the gate, and that he has not been so ashamed or so proud in five autumns.

options.label: Fear what the Hollow will take for it next autumn

effects.text: Ask the stranger what Thornhaven does next year, when the Hollow comes back for what the gate cost it.

beats.title: She Walks Out
beats.summary: Nobody was holding her. While the village faced the cart, Elena walked out of the line to it and climbed in.

hooks.situation: She walked out of the line and climbed into the cart before you could reach her.

options.label: Run after the cart
Fall to his knees in the road

hooks.situation: Elena walked to the cart while you stood in the front rank.

options.label: Tell the stranger he will follow the ruts

effects.text: Tell the stranger he's going after that cart, ridge or no ridge. He let her walk past him.

options.label: Stand where he is

beats.title: The Gate Turned
beats.summary: The line faces the Kingsroad side, where the widow said the cart would come, and four Hollow men come up the mill road behind it. In the press, Varn sees his chance at Elena.

hooks.situation: The line is facing the wrong road. The merchant's girl is right there, with nobody holding her. The hut off the trail is stocked. The widow is behind her bar.

options.label: Take Elena into the cart and turn it toward his hut, for himself
Keep to the Boss's plan and break the line

effects.text: Tell the stranger the line broke on the mill road, as lines do. Next year they'll know better.

hooks.situation: They came up the mill road behind you. The widow said the Kingsroad side.

options.label: Rally the six at the chapel line

effects.text: Tell the stranger they came up the mill road behind him. Somebody's word was wrong.

options.label: Begin, for the first time, to doubt the widow

beats.title: The Empty Cart
beats.summary: The stranger stood, the village stood with them, and the Hollow's men broke at Thornhaven's gate. The cart goes back up the road empty.

hooks.situation: The cart is going back up the road empty, and every man in the Hollow saw it.

options.label: Ride for the camp and take the Hollow in his own name before the widow can blame him

effects.text: Tell the stranger, if he sees them again, that the Hollow has a new master and a long memory.

options.label: Pull back into the Darkwood and plan the reprisal

effects.text: Let the stranger know the Hollow will be back for what it was owed, with interest.

hooks.situation: The village stood. All at once, together, at the gate. Your worst nightmare, and the widow must weep with joy.

options.label: Mark every face that stood, for next year

effects.text: Weep with relief at the stranger's side, and ask the names of everyone who stood.

options.label: Make sure the reprisal is laid at Gregor's door

effects.text: Whisper to the stranger that the Hollow will want Gregor now. It was always his bargain.

hooks.situation: Nobody went. And Corin and Willa are still up there.

options.label: Turn the stranger toward the ridge

effects.text: Tell the stranger nobody went tonight, and Corin and Willa are still up there. It isn't over.

options.label: Find her father

beats.title: Coin at the Gate
beats.summary: Collection Night. The undercroft coin waits at the gate in iron-bound chests. Varn's cart comes down the road, and the Hollow names its terms.

hooks.situation: Your key opened the undercroft for the last time. The fund is at the gate. Will you bring all of it?

options.label: Bring up every coin

effects.text: Tell the stranger every coin from the undercroft is at the gate. Let it buy her back.

options.label: Hold back half against a second name

effects.text: Tell the stranger he held back half. If the Hollow asks a second name, there must be something left.

hooks.situation: The village means to buy the girl back with its tribute fund. The Hollow's terms are yours to set.

options.label: The Tithe's old terms: the coin and the girl both
Let the coin buy the girl this once, so Thornhaven learns that paying works

effects.text: Weep with the stranger at the gate and say the men must have mercy in them after all.

hooks.situation: The council's coin is at the gate. Yours is in the strongbox. Everything is for sale tonight.

options.label: Add his strongbox to the purse

effects.text: Tell the stranger the strongbox is on the cart's tailboard too. Every coin he ever saved.

options.label: Keep the road money back, in case

hooks.situation: Chests of coin at the gate, and the merchant's girl behind them. The widow will count every penny of it in her little book.

options.label: Count the coin and keep to the widow's terms

effects.text: Tell the stranger it's a pleasure doing business with Thornhaven.

options.label: If the girl rides, turn the cart toward his hut

hooks.situation: The stranger handed the village's coin up to the Hollow's cart. Every farmer at the gate saw it.

options.label: Tell them plainly what the six saw: coin for the Hollow

effects.text: Tell the stranger the six watched them pay the Hollow, and that coin buys next year's cart too.

options.label: Say nothing; it bought a life, if it bought anything

effects.text: Ask the stranger quietly whether the coin bought Elena or only bought the Hollow another year.

beats.title: The Coin and the Girl
beats.summary: The Hollow took the coin, and then it took Elena too, as the Tithe always had. The bargain was never with Varn.

hooks.situation: They took the coin and her both.

options.label: Run after the cart
Go to Mira: she said the men would take coin

effects.text: Tell the stranger he is going to Mira. She carried the men's word. She will know what went wrong.

hooks.situation: They took the coin and you anyway. You never wanted to be bought.

options.label: Ride without fear; this was always her road
Count the bends of the trail

beats.title: A Face in the Cart
beats.summary: Collection Night. A different face will ride the cart: Gregor's, the stranger's, or another of Thornhaven's people's, quietly, the lot rigged once more. The stranger decides whose.

hooks.situation: The cart has stopped at the gate. A different face is going up the ridge tonight. You have a purse, a drifter from the mill, and your own two legs.

options.label: Climb onto the tailboard and offer himself

effects.text: Tell the stranger it's him. It was always going to be him. Let him go.

options.label: Push the drifter from the mill forward with a purse in his hand

effects.text: Tell the stranger the drifter from the mill will go for the purse. Nobody will miss him. Say yes.

options.label: Offer the stranger his strongbox to ride in her place

effects.text: Offer the stranger every coin he owns to ride the cart in Elena's place. Name it.

hooks.situation: Everything is written over to Elena. The boots are laced. Your legs have nothing left to argue with.

options.label: Stand ready
Shake, and hate himself for shaking

hooks.situation: They are deciding who rides in your place. Your father, the stranger, some quiet name. Exactly what you cut your own tile to stop.

options.label: Stand before the cart and say her own name aloud
Beg her father to come down off the tailboard

effects.text: Elena begged him at the tailboard: come down. It's her name. It was always her name.

hooks.situation: They mean to put another face in the cart. The count is the count. But the girl is the prize.

options.label: Take whatever face fills the cart, so long as the count is right

effects.text: Tell the stranger the Hollow is not particular tonight. One is one.

options.label: Say aloud that he wants the merchant's girl

effects.text: Tell the stranger, softly, that the girl is worth more than any face they offer. Think about the price.

hooks.situation: Elena has said her own name before the cart. The lot named her. You read it.

options.label: Say the lot named her and the gods chose

effects.text: Tell the stranger the lot named Elena, and he will not stand in the way of it.

options.label: Say aloud that the lot was rigged, and no name in it binds anyone

effects.text: Say before the gate that the lot was rigged. No name in it binds anyone, Elena least of all.

hooks.situation: A different face rode up the ridge. The Pit has its digger, and you know now who in Thornhaven will send a neighbour to save their own.

options.label: Write next year's slip in her head
Count what Gregor will do for her now

hooks.situation: The stranger let another of Thornhaven's people be put in the cart in Elena's place. A quiet name, a rigged lot. Like Gregor.

options.label: Tell them to their face the forge is shut to them

effects.text: Tell the stranger to their face that they did what Gregor did, and that his forge is shut to them.

options.label: Ask whose name went, so he can tell the family himself

effects.text: Ask the stranger whose name went up the ridge, so he can stand at that family's door himself.

beats.title: Her Name Stands
beats.summary: Collection Night. Elena walks out to the cart as she chose. The stranger can stay outside as her eyes, or follow the cart up the ridge to wherever the taken go.

hooks.situation: Every name is in the hem. Somebody outside has to know how to read it.

options.label: Show the stranger the last stitch and where to look for the next

effects.text: Show the stranger the last stitch: the dead pine, the hut, the hours. Look for thread on the thorns.

options.label: Keep it close

hooks.situation: Your daughter is walking to the cart with the stranger at her side, and every door you knocked on is shut.

options.label: Beg her one last time at the gate

effects.text: Beg Elena at the gate, in front of everyone, not to get in.

options.label: Offer Varn his strongbox for a gentler road

effects.text: Gregor pressed his strongbox key into his hand at the gate: be gentle with her.

hooks.situation: The merchant's girl is walking to your cart on her own feet. The hut off the trail is stocked, the bolt is on the outside, the two men are yours.

options.label: Walk the cart up the ridge as always

effects.text: Tell the stranger they look like someone who might follow a cart. The ridge is long and the night is dark.

options.label: Turn the cart onto his second road, to the hut

hooks.situation: The widow has marked you. Her two men are walking beside your cart.

options.label: Move first
Smile, and count them

hooks.situation: The girl is walking to the cart, exactly as you let her. Varn is at the tailboard, watching her like a strongbox.

options.label: Wrap Elena in Marcus's shawl at the gate

effects.text: Mira wrapped her in Marcus's shawl at the gate and kissed her forehead. The ridge is cold, love.

options.label: Send her two knives to walk beside the cart

hooks.situation: The girl whose pony you shod is walking to the Hollow's cart, and the stranger is letting her.

options.label: Press a small smith's file into the heel of her boot, for chains

effects.text: Bjorn knelt at the gate, retied her boot and said nothing. There's a file in the heel now.

options.label: Stay at the forge; he cannot watch another cart

beats.title: The Pit
beats.summary: The smugglers' ridge trail from Iron Hollow: five hours past a dead pine and a shepherd's hut to a back-seam of Greystone's deep vein, where Corin Ashby and Willa Brand dig white salt in chains.

hooks.situation: The cart has gone up the ridge. If anyone follows it, it will be tonight.

options.label: Double the guard on the Pit's mouth
Leave the usual two; nobody has ever walked the ridge

hooks.situation: Ashguard has a picket on the ridge trail over Greystone. The far half of your road is watched.

options.label: Send the salt round by the Darkwood
Feel the walls closing

hooks.situation: Greystone has torn down the boards below its seventh level. Picks are ringing on the other side of Dagna's seal.

options.label: Move the diggers deeper into the back-seam

effects.text: Tell the stranger, if they reach the Pit, that the diggers aren't where they used to be.

options.label: Let them dig; the seal is a wall either way

hooks.situation: You drew the way in ash for the stranger. Now they are going. The first mile is the worst.

options.label: Walk the first mile of the ridge trail again, to show the way
Stay at Maud's

hooks.situation: Your iron sent your boy up this trail. The ones still below are somebody's boys too.

options.label: Shoulder his heaviest hammer and walk the ridge with the stranger
Stay at the forge

hooks.situation: The cart has carried you up the ridge. Wherever it set you down, the Pit's diggers are near, and one of them, a young man with a leader's eyes, must be Corin Ashby.

options.label: Whisper to Corin that someone from outside is coming
Keep her head down and her cough quiet

effects.text: If the stranger reaches the Pit, she's at the wet end, coughing quietly. Look for the girl in Marcus's shawl.

hooks.situation: The men at the tailboard are saying the cart is not going to the Pit tonight, but to a hut off the trail that answers to Varn alone. You are the bargain after all.

options.label: Leave thread from her hem on the thorns where the cart turns off the trail

effects.text: If the stranger follows, look for blue thread on the thorns where the cart left the ridge trail. She'll be past it.

options.label: Set her jaw: she will not be anyone's strongbox

hooks.situation: The stranger is following the cart up the ridge. At the top is the Pit, and the tally book in your own hand.

options.label: Climb the ridge herself, mask off, to reach the tally book first
Send word up to Varn to watch the trail behind the cart

effects.text: The widow's word came up the ridge: the stranger is behind the cart. Deal with it before the Pit.

options.label: Stay behind the bar

hooks.situation: The gate held. Up the ridge, the taken are still in chains.

options.label: March the six up the ridge after the cart ruts

effects.text: Tell the stranger he's taking the six up the ridge. If the taken live, he means to bring them home.

options.label: Keep the six home; the reprisal will come

beats.title: The Pit Before the Cart
beats.summary: The stranger has the ridge trail and knows the taken are alive. If they reach the Pit before Collection Night and break the chains, there is nothing left for the cart to fill.

hooks.situation: Your man on the ridge says somebody has been walking the smugglers' trail who has no business on it, days before any cart.

options.label: Double the guard on the Pit's mouth now

effects.text: Ask the stranger, friendly, whether they like walking in the hills. The hills are dangerous this autumn.

options.label: Watch the trail himself, and tell the Boss nothing

hooks.situation: The stranger knows the ridge trail and knows the taken live. If they reach the Pit before the cart, the harvest is over and the tally book in your hand is waiting for them.

options.label: Send the cart early, so the ridge is thick with her men when they get there

effects.reason: The Boss learned the ridge trail was being walked, and sent the cart early so the ridge would be thick with her men.

options.label: Send for the tally book and say nothing

effects.text: Ask the stranger, worried, whether they have been walking in the hills. Marcus walked in the hills.

hooks.situation: The stranger means to go up to the Pit before any cart. No chains on you this time. Corin and Willa are at the bottom of it.

options.label: Walk the first mile of the trail again, shaking, and show the way

effects.text: Tell the stranger every turn of the ridge trail to the dead pine, and where the guards stand at the Pit's mouth.

options.label: Stay hidden at Maud's, and pray

hooks.situation: The stranger is going up the ridge before the cart. Your iron sent your boy up that trail.

options.label: Shoulder his heaviest hammer and go too
Keep the forge lit for whoever comes back

beats.title: The Empty Harvest
beats.summary: The Pit was emptied before the cart could come, and no cart came. Thornhaven stands at an open gate on the night it dreaded, waiting for its children to walk home, and the Boss has nothing left to harvest.

hooks.situation: No cart tonight. The Pit is empty and the tally book's columns end. Five years built on a lot and a cart, and both are gone in a week.

options.label: Weep at the gate with the village; the widow never did anything but grieve

effects.text: Hold the stranger's hands at the gate and thank them, weeping, for bringing the children home.

options.label: Pack the tavern's strongbox and take the Kingsroad before anyone asks
Send word to the camp: burn a barn, so the valley remembers

effects.text: The widow's word: burn one barn in Thornhaven, so the valley remembers what refusing costs.

hooks.situation: No cart, no Pit, no salt. A camp of men with nothing to guard is a camp of men counting what they are owed, and looking at you.

options.label: Take the camp tonight, in his own name, while the Boss is weeping somewhere

effects.text: Tell the stranger the Hollow has a new master tonight, and ask what they will do about it.

options.label: Go looking for the stranger who emptied his Pit
Take what silver he hid and ride east

hooks.situation: No name will be read this autumn. The taken are on the road home. The bell rope is in your hand.

options.label: Ring the chapel bell and read the five names as names of the living

effects.text: Ask the stranger to stand beside him while he reads the names of the taken as the names of the living.

options.label: Open the undercroft and give the tribute fund back to the families

effects.text: Tell the stranger the tribute fund goes back to the families tonight, coin by coin, in front of everyone.

hooks.situation: No cart came. Elena is safe. And the salt that kept her alive came out of that Pit, which is empty now.

options.label: Tell Elena everything tonight, at their table

effects.text: Ask the stranger to sit with him while he tells Elena where her medicine came from.

options.label: Count the packets left in the strongbox, and say nothing

effects.text: Ask the stranger, low, whether anyone up at the Pit knew how to find more of the white salt.

hooks.situation: Nobody's name was read. The gate is open and Corin and Willa are on the road. You were going to walk up there yourself.

options.label: Go out on the road to meet them

effects.text: Ask the stranger to walk out on the road with her to meet the taken coming home.

options.label: Ask the stranger what roads there are beyond the valley

effects.text: Ask the stranger what lies past the Kingsroad, now that she will not be walking the ridge.

hooks.situation: Corin is coming down the road. You swore on the seam you would come back for him. He came back for himself.

options.label: Stand at the gate where Corin will see him first

effects.text: Ask the stranger to stand with him at the gate. He wants Corin to see a face he knows first.

options.label: Find Hesk Marlow's widow and tell her he did not die alone

effects.text: Tell the stranger he means to find Hesk Marlow's widow tonight and tell her Hesk did not die alone.

beats.title: The Widow's Hand
beats.summary: Only on the last night, and only if earned, does Mira's truth surface: at the gate when the plan threatens the Pit, in the Pit's tally book in her own hand, or in Aldric's sealed account of the night Marcus died.

hooks.situation: Your sealed account of the night Marcus died: the widow's word, and your note that from her kitchen door she could not have seen the yard.

options.label: Break the seal and read it aloud at the gate

effects.text: Tell the stranger what he wrote down: Mira could not have seen what she says she saw. He doesn't want to believe it.

options.label: Keep it sealed for Varn's trial

hooks.situation: The stranger has brought down the Pit's tally book. Salt and names, in a neat, practised hand you have seen on the Rusty Nail's slate a thousand times.

options.label: Say whose hand it is

effects.text: Tell the stranger, shaking, whose hand kept that book. He has read her tavern accounts for years.

options.label: Close the book and say nothing

hooks.situation: The stranger has your tally book. Your own neat hand. The mask has one crack in it now that will not close.

options.label: Come to the stranger mask off, and offer them a place beside her

effects.text: Speak to the stranger level and unhurried, mask off. Offer them a place beside her, and see whether they run.

options.label: Weep, and say Varn made her keep it

effects.text: Weep to the stranger that Varn made her keep his book, that she only ever carried messages.

hooks.situation: Letters from the Halfway House are saying in the Capitol that the Boss keeps a tavern in Thornhaven.

options.label: Burn every trail that leads to her
Feel, for the first time, how it would be to be seen

hooks.situation: Varn has taken the Hollow. Your lieutenant sits in your chair.

options.label: Remember the two knives at her back door

effects.text: Ask the stranger, low, whether they would stand with a widow against the man who killed her husband.

options.label: Wait; men who take chairs fall out of them

hooks.situation: The village knows. The widow is the Boss, and the Hollow knows it was run from a tavern kitchen.

options.label: Take the Hollow in his own name
Ride for Greystone before the valley comes for the Hollow

hooks.situation: Mira. The messenger who wept at your table five years ago. The salt, the slips, the names.

options.label: Understand what she made of him

effects.text: Tell the stranger: five years she wept at his table. Every name came folded in her salt.

options.label: Go to the tavern

hooks.situation: Mira. Honey for the cough, the seat by the fire. She was in the back pew that evening.

options.label: Understand that she was watched
Take off Marcus's shawl

effects.text: Tell the stranger she took off Marcus's shawl and left it in the road.

beats.title: The Cart Comes
beats.summary: Collection Night, and Thornhaven chose nothing. Varn's cart comes down the road to the gate, and Elena goes out to it alone.

hooks.situation: The gate is quiet. No steel, no coin, no stranger. The merchant's girl is waiting.

options.label: Take the coin and the girl and walk the ridge by dawn
Take the girl and turn the cart toward his hut

hooks.situation: The cart is at the gate. Nobody is coming to stop it, and nobody is coming to follow it. It's your name.

options.label: Walk out to the cart before her father wakes
Let them take her from the shop door, holding her father's hand

hooks.situation: The cart is at the gate and every door is shut.

options.label: Run to the cart and beg Varn

effects.text: The merchant ran to the cart in his shirt and begged. Name it, he said. Name it.

options.label: Stand in the shop doorway and cannot move

hooks.situation: The cart rolled. The girl is in it. Nobody fought.

options.label: Choose next year's name
Put away the honey jar

hooks.situation: Another cart. You stood at the back again.

options.label: Swear it is the last
Go back to the anvil

hooks.situation: The fifth cart. You read the name.

options.label: Pray
Count the mothers' faces

endings.title: The Homecoming, Unmasked
endings.summary: The Pit was emptied before the cart could come, and no cart came. The stranger walked the taken home through an open gate and named the widow of the Rusty Nail before the village that night. Thornhaven's Collection Night became the night its children came back.

endings.title: The Homecoming
endings.summary: No cart came, because the Pit it would have filled was already empty. The stranger walked Corin Ashby, Willa Brand and the others home through the gate on the night Thornhaven had dreaded for five autumns. Who ran the Tithe is still a question the valley is asking.

endings.title: The Widow Without a Cart
endings.summary: The Pit was emptied and no cart came, and the stranger named the widow of the Rusty Nail as the Boss of Iron Hollow before a village with nothing left to fear from her.

endings.title: The Night No Cart Came
endings.summary: The stranger reached the Pit before Collection Night and broke the chains. The night came, and no cart came with it; Thornhaven stood at its gate until dawn, waiting for something that would never come again.

endings.title: The Open Pit
endings.summary: The stranger reached the Pit and freed the taken. Corin and Willa came home, the Tithe ended, and the white-salt trade lay open for the Cathedral, the Guild and the Capitol to answer for.

endings.title: The Stranger's Price
endings.summary: The stranger rode the Hollow's cart in Elena's place and went up the ridge to the Pit.

endings.title: The Father's Price
endings.summary: Gregor climbed into the cart in his daughter's place and went up the ridge to the Pit. Elena lived, and lived with it.

endings.title: The Empty Cart
endings.summary: Thornhaven stood at its gate with the stranger and the Hollow broke. Nobody went. The valley was free, and afraid of what would come back down the road.

endings.title: The Old Bargain
endings.summary: Another of Thornhaven's people was quietly sent in Elena's place, the lot rigged once more, and the stranger was part of it. The rot went on.

endings.title: The Lot Stands
endings.summary: Elena went as she chose, and the stranger stayed outside as her eyes. She became the spy inside the Pit, and a rescue became possible.

endings.title: The Widow's Harvest
endings.summary: The undercroft coin went up the road on the Boss's terms and the widow was never seen for what she was. The Tithe went on, and next year's name was already chosen.

endings.title: The Cart Rolled
endings.summary: Collection Night came and Thornhaven had chosen nothing. Elena went up the ridge alone. The world moved on without the stranger.
